load_vln_dataset: create a VLNDatasetV1 instance from a DictConfig to load a gzipped R2RVLN-v1 dataset with episodes and instruction vocabulary
parse_json_to_episodes: call from_json on VLNDatasetV1 to parse a JSON string into VLNEpisode objects with navigation goals and instructions
check_config_paths: call check_config_paths_exist with a DictConfig to verify the dataset file and scenes directory exist before loading
register_dataset: use the R2RVLN-v1 registry name to instantiate VLNDatasetV1 through Habitat's dataset registry system
filter_episodes_by_scenes: pass a config to VLNDatasetV1 init to automatically filter episodes using build_content_scenes_filter based on scene availability
